title: Weaver migrated routing policy
description: Upstream-compatible policy shape. Weaver validates structure and cross-object rules; policy eligibility is not verified provider execution support.

chatgpt_review.description: Review policy preference; missing means enabled. No automatic external review integration is implemented.

quota.description: Scheduled native account quota refresh. Missing means enabled every 15 minutes. Exhausted accounts block their engines until a fresh available observation or the reset time.

engines.description: Agent CLI engines keyed by engine id.

owners.description: Owner agents keyed by owner id. Each enabled engine has at most one enabled owner.

workers.description: Workers keyed by worker id; every id ends with _worker.

herdr.description: Legacy compatibility metadata only. Does not enable or configure a Weaver transport.

max_wait_minutes.description: Retained upstream wait preference, unused by current Weaver runtime.

effort.description: Engine-native effort. Allowed set depends on the engine kind: claude low|medium|high|xhigh|max; codex low|medium|high|xhigh|max; grok none|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max; pi off|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max; other kinds (e.g. opencode, whose --variant is provider/model specific) any non-empty string. Checked by the script.

kind.description: Upstream provider vocabulary for policy matching, not an installed capability.

quota_refresh.description: Whether scheduled quota refresh probes this engine and may auto-block it when the account quota is exhausted. Missing means on for codex, claude and grok, which have a quota probe, and off for every other kind.

workers.description: Worker ids this owner may dispatch to. Ties in worker_weights keep this list order.

max_parallel.description: Cap on workers (native and herdr) running concurrently for this owner; the owner enforces it by counting running ledger entries.

worker_weights.description: Priority weight per worker, integer 0..10. Omitted means 5. Higher weight is tried first; 0 excludes that worker for this owner. This is priority, not a random probability. Every key must be in workers.
